Game Overview

Kidnapped Again is a platformer title where embark on a whimsical rescue mission to save the princess from a persistently villainous wizard. Engage in strategic combat by precisely timing your shield to fend off foes and navigate knockback from crafty animals in this charmingly humorous adventure. Can you end the endless cycle of kidnappings?
